skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply advanced macroeconomic theories to analyze macroeconomic relationships and the operation of the overall economy.
Evaluate the impact of economic events and policy changes on the overall economy using advanced macroeconomic theories.
Develop skills in collecting data, synthesizing secondary materials, and applying analytical tools in economics to real-world situations.

Develop independent research skills, teamwork abilities, and presentation skills to communicate knowledge through writing and discussing real-world macroeconomic situations in Vietnam and other countries.
Enhance self-learning and research abilities to improve knowledge related to real-world macroeconomic issues.
Enhance critical thinking skills regarding macroeconomic issues in Vietnam and other countries.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics when making judgments and evaluations about macroeconomic programs.
